context.conversationContext:
Zheng: 谢谢！对不起。
Thank you! Sorry.

sources.title: 谢谢 — learning card
sources.excerpt: 谢谢 (xiè xiè) — thank you. Sense: thank you. Assessed skill: recognition.

sources.title: 对不起 — learning card
sources.excerpt: 对不起 (duì bù qǐ) — sorry. Sense: sorry. Assessed skill: recognition.

waypoints.objective: Recognize 谢谢 as the expression used to thank someone.
waypoints.explanation: 谢谢 is the standard Mandarin phrase for expressing gratitude. It is used when someone has helped you, given you something, or done a kind act.

revision.reason: The lesson currently only teaches 谢谢 (thank you), but the objective is to distinguish thanking from apologizing. A waypoint for 对不起 (sorry) is missing to complete the contrast.
